prompts.hoplite:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production pixel-art sprite atlas for an SNES-style Godot platformer.
Image 1 is the edit target: the source enemy atlas, exactly 648 by 56 pixels, with nine equal 72 by 56 cells in one horizontal row. Image 2 is ONLY the quality/style reference, Theseus; do not change or reproduce Theseus.
Draw a living Greek hoplite drawn with precisely the same fine pixel scale, anatomical proportions, warm bronze shading, dark outlines, facial detail and cloth folds as Theseus. Bronze Corinthian helmet and red crest, shaded ivory linen tunic with bronze cuirass, leather sandals and greaves, a round bronze shield with a clear dark inner rim, and a slender long spear. Distinct from Theseus through the round shield and heavier helmet.
Preserve the nine cells, right-facing profile, transparent background, no labels, no outlines around cells, no scenery. Every arm has a shoulder, elbow and gripping hand; every leg has thigh, knee, calf and foot.
Frame order must remain: 0 very low crouch behind shield; 1 half-risen crouch; 2 standing ready; 3-6 four alternating march poses; 7 braced spear windup; 8 extended horizontal spear thrust. Feet/lowest visible solid pixel aligned to y=53 in every cell; standing height about 43 pixels including crest. Body centered x=36 in each cell. All weapons remain inside each cell, with thrust reaching toward x=69. Keep the full canvas exactly 648x56 if possible. Crisp individual square pixels, limited material ramps, no blur, no smooth vector artwork, no antialiasing, no enormous heads, no stick limbs. True transparent alpha.
prompts.peltast:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for a Godot SNES-style side-scroller.
Image 1 is the source enemy atlas: seven frames in one horizontal row. Image 2 is Theseus, solely the reference for pixel scale, believable human anatomy, warm skin, cloth shading, bronze metal, dark outlines and overall quality.
Draw a living human Greek peltast soldier, standing about the SAME height and slim athletic proportions as Theseus. Bronze open-faced helmet with small dark teal horsehair crest, shaded teal short tunic, leather belt and diagonal chest strap, bare warm-colored arms and knees, bronze shin guards and leather sandals. A small brown satchel of green ceramic poison flasks is fixed at his rear hip. Clearly human face, eye, nose, chin, hands attached to arms, thick thighs and bent knees. Every material has distinct three-tone shaded pixels.
Exactly seven separate full-body right-facing poses, same scale and baseline: 0 walk left leg forward; 1 passing stance; 2 walk right leg forward; 3 second passing stance; 4 flask held back in throwing windup; 5 throwing arm extended right with hand empty; 6 throwing follow-through. Frames 4-6 have a readable dynamic bent-knee throwing stance. Same character and costume across all frames. No detached projectile in the sheet.
Preserve atlas contract of 72x56 per frame, seven frames, target 504x56 canvas. Feet row 53, body pivot x36, standing height 43 pixels including crest. Transparent alpha with generous clear separation between characters. No scenery, labels, text, drop shadows, grids, gradients, blurred edges or smooth vector art. Fine crisp pixel art consistent with Theseus; no chibi stocky proportions. Keep all hands, feet and equipment within their frame.
prompts.raider:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for a Godot SNES-style side-scroller.
Image 1 is the source enemy atlas: seven frames in one horizontal row. Image 2 is Theseus, ONLY the reference for fine pixel scale, slim adult human anatomy, warm skin, shaded bronze equipment, cloth folds, dark outlines and quality.
Draw a living human Greek sword raider visually related to Theseus. Bronze cheek-guard helmet with a dark red horsehair crest, shaded crimson short tunic, leather belt and shoulder strap, a small dark red cape, warm skin arms and knees, bronze greaves, leather sandals and a short curved iron kopis sword held in the forward hand. Readable face and eye, chest-waist-hip silhouette, attached arms and hands, muscular thighs, knees, calves and feet. Distinguish cloth, skin, bronze and iron with light and dark ramps.
Exactly seven full-body right-facing poses, consistent scale: 0 walk left leg forward; 1 passing stance; 2 walk right leg forward; 3 second passing stance; 4 low bent-knee sword windup; 5 very low forward sword lunge with torso near horizontal, front knee bent and rear leg stretched back; 6 crouched exhausted recovery with sword lowered, torso leaning forward and head down. Sword blade points toward right in attack frame. No fire or smoke in the sheet.
Preserve 72x56 cell layout, seven frames, target canvas504x56. Feet row53, body pivotx36, standing height43 pixels including helmet. True transparent alpha, clear gaps between frames, no ground plane, no drop shadows, labels, borders, text, background, blur or smooth vector look. Match Theseus's slender adult proportions and fine pixel-art texture; do not produce chibi stocky characters. Weapons and feet must stay fully within each frame.
